integrity: The proof uses only the source definitions of facet mass, ridge conductance, Dirichlet form, and evenness. Facet and ridge volumes and the dihedral angle are computed explicitly, reducing the operator to a scalar multiple of the Boolean-hypercube Laplacian. The source main variational theorem is not used. The bundled checker verifies the resulting Walsh spectrum exactly in dimensions 2 through 8 as a consistency test.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the Hu--Ivaki facet-network spectrum only for the regular cross-polytope (and its centro-affine linear images). It does not address arbitrary simplicial or unconditional polytopes and does not claim local extremality for the cross-polytope.
title: Complete even centro-affine facet spectrum of the regular cross-polytope
